settings.title: App Insights Settings
settings.description: Configure one or more Personal Access Tokens to track your Homey apps.
settings.test_no_token: Enter a Personal Access Token first.
settings.no_tokens_yet: No Personal Access Tokens configured yet. Add one below.
settings.token_instructions_intro: To get a Personal Access Token:
settings.token_step_open: Open tools.developer.homey.app/me and sign in with your Athom account.
settings.token_step_copy: In the Personal Access Token section, copy the token (it starts with pat-).
settings.token_step_paste: Paste it above and press Test to verify, then Add.

errors.missing_personal_access_token: No Personal Access Token has been configured yet. Open the app's settings to add one.
